summary:
Main
The iron ore market showed a lackluster performance on the spot today. The DCE main contract I2609 closed at 715 yuan/ton, down 3.31%from the previous trading session. Spot prices at Qingdao Port fell by 15-20 yuan/ton from the previous trading day.
